text.en:
Subject to the rules and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and
thirty-six, there is hereby granted to "Misamis Lumber Company, Incorporated," for a period of fifty years
from the approval of this Act, the right, privilege and authority to construct, maintain and operate an electric
light, heat and power system for the purpose of generating and distributing electric light, heat and power, for
sale within the limits of the municipalities of Misamis, Clarin and Tudela, Province of Occidental Misamis,
Philippine Islands.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 28, 1930.
